source_caption_text:
YouTuber #Brawadis (Brandon Awadis) revealed that he changes his daily schedule just to see his girlfriend Jasmine during her lunch break, saying he doesn’t want her to ever “feel alone.” 

The revelation comes after the couple has endured major turmoil in their relationship, including Jasmine cheating on Brandon and putting their relationship through a serious breach of trust.

Despite everything they’ve been through, Brandon says he still makes an effort to be there for her and prioritize her, even if it means rearranging his own day.

His actions have sparked mixed reactions, with fans questioning whether this is true love and forgiveness — or if Brandon is giving too much of himself after everything that happened.

Is Brandon Wrong or right for this?❤️‍🩹
